t: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 7320 Reseda Boulevard in Reseda, California, shall be known and designated as the “Coach John Wooden Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a Postal Service facility. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given any right to object or sue over a federal decision; there is no tempting participation language at all.
